sections.changelog:
Added

  • Restrict user registration to e-mail addresses in allowed domain zones (e.g. `.ru`, `.рф`, `.by`) via the native `registration_errors` filter.
  • WooCommerce registration coverage (My Account and checkout) via `woocommerce_registration_errors`.
  • Admin settings screen: enable toggle + one-zone-per-line whitelist textarea.
  • Cyrillic zone support (`.рф` matched against its punycode `.xn--p1ai`).
  • Russian (ru_RU) translation.
